scenarios.failure: Buffer capacity exceeded (10,000 events in backlog)
scenarios.expected: Explicit BufferFullError raised or routed to DLQ; no silent dropping
scenarios.actual: BufferFullError raised on REJECT; DLQ overflow recorded on DLQ policy

scenarios.failure: Disk payload bit-rot or manual adversary tampering
scenarios.expected: StorageIntegrityError raised on read; corrupted payload never delivered
scenarios.actual: SHA-256 verification mismatch detected; StorageIntegrityError raised

scenarios.failure: SIEM downstream sink offline or throwing HTTP 503
scenarios.expected: OCSF and OTel sinks succeed; SIEM failure marked in Outbox; pipeline unaffected
scenarios.actual: Partial fan-out failure isolated; SIEM marked FAILED; canonical pipeline intact

scenarios.failure: Search index in-memory crash or catastrophic deletion
scenarios.expected: Zero canonical data loss; index rebuilt deterministically from UCE/semantic store
scenarios.actual: rebuild_index() repopulated all 15 records with identical IDs and attributes

scenarios.failure: Poison payload (nested null bytes, malformed framing)
scenarios.expected: Pipeline does not crash worker; event routed to DLQManager with error context
scenarios.actual: DLQRecord created with error_type and payload_preview; worker continues
